architecture_contract.selection_rule: Do not infer an architecture from the display name. Any selected graph transformer becomes a new immutable model identity with its own source, license, semantics, and audit.

held_source_output_contract.admissible_future_output: one source-agnostic continuous candidate-gene score per frozen row, calibrated without the evaluated source
held_source_output_contract.held_source_token_rule: A source ID, source token, source-specific decoder, source observability mask, or positional encoding derived from the held source cannot be present at prediction time.
held_source_output_contract.relation_identifiability: A completely unseen source type cannot have a learned source-specific output parameter. Recovery must be source-agnostic cross-source prioritization.

inductive_transductive_contract.minimum_inductive_requirement: No per-entity learned ID embedding; frozen feature transforms for a new node of an existing type; trained parameters for every admitted type; and no graph-wide preprocessing refit on query nodes or held edges.
inductive_transductive_contract.transductive_risk: Entity-ID embeddings, a fixed graph token table, graph-wide attention over the complete node universe, or positional encodings fit on the full graph make the model transductive.

input_and_leakage_contract.attention_mask: Must be built after held-source and held-locus removal. A mask derived from the full graph leaks topology even if held edge values are hidden.
input_and_leakage_contract.continuous_evidence: Must preserve assay-native units or an explicitly frozen training-only transform. Evidence absence is not zero.
input_and_leakage_contract.graph_position: Laplacian eigenvectors, random-walk statistics, centrality, shortest paths, metapaths, degree encodings, source counts, and graph token order are graph-derived features and must be recomputed from the split-safe training graph.
input_and_leakage_contract.missingness: Preserve supported, discordant, tested-negative, untestable, not-applicable, source-dependent, and indeterminate states with explicit masks.
input_and_leakage_contract.node_universe: Must be source-independent. Nodes whose existence or type is disclosed only by the held source remain evaluator-only.
input_and_leakage_contract.provenance: Source labels and assay observability are inputs only for remaining evidence. The removed source's provenance and eligibility are withheld with its outcomes.

runtime_contract.slurm_rule: No job, test, or implementation probe may be scheduled for this unresolved model.
